# Fix All Code Quality Issues

Auto-fix code quality issues (Pint, Rector, PHPStan, ESLint, tsc) in sequence.

## Instructions

1. Run Pint for code style (auto-fix):
```bash
   composer fix
```

2. Run Rector for refactoring (apply fixes):
```bash
   composer rector:fix
```

3. Run PHPStan and report any remaining issues:
```bash
   composer phpstan
```

4. Run frontend linting:
```bash
   cd resources/frontend && npm run lint:fix
```

5. Run tests to verify nothing broke:
```bash
   composer test
```

6. Summarize what was fixed and any remaining issues.
